old_description: , we specialize in fine custom furniture and cabinetry and also offer heirloom furniture refinishing. Each piece is carefully crafted using quality materials and close attention to detail, creating furniture that is both beautiful and built to last.
about:
Honolulu Furniture Company was founded in 2008 by German furniture maker Thorben Wuttke in Honolulu, Hawaii. Operating from a studio on Cummins Street in the Kakaako district, the company began as a custom woodworking shop focused on building furniture locally for clients across Oahu.

The company produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and heirloom furniture refinishing. Each piece is crafted using quality woods and finished with a two-part acrylic polyurethane for durability. The shop handles projects from design through fabrication, with a typical turnaround of eight to ten weeks.

Honolulu Furniture Company serves homeowners, architects, interior designers, and commercial businesses throughout Oahu. Its residential and commercial manufacturing capabilities address projects ranging from single custom pieces to larger contract installations for hospitality and office environments.

The firm emphasizes a tailored approach and generations-lasting craftsmanship, positioning itself as a manufacturer rather than a retail showroom. Wuttke’s background in German furniture making informs the studio’s attention to detail and commitment to locally built, enduring pieces.
